1003-3899-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-3899-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

710-2511-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-2511-8207.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

141-653-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-5256.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

116-757-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

997-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
997-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

489-1965-2034-5224.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2366-3688-5702-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-5702-6965.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

6709-6867-7042.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
6709-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa, Steadfast Guardian enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-3025-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2232-2921-3821-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2921-3821-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

2438-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1430-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image
1430-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirror Image's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mirror Image's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Mirror Image's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-4063-5686-6625.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

500-851-1308-2523.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-1308-2523.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3372-4068-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4068-5231-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
3372-4068-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

884-1339-1400-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Ayara.
884-1339-1400-2178.description:
Activate Ayara by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ayara triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Ayara ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

950-1636-5251.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Emmara do not have summoning sickness.
950-1636-5251.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

253-3658.description:
At the beginning of the end step prior to your turn, Form of the Dragon's second ability triggers, causing your life total to become five.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Form of the Dragon's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, causing you and an opponent to swap life totals.
Resolve the Form of the Dragon trigger, dealing five damage to the opponent who you swapped life totals with.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

659-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
659-2034-2178.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin token, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin dies, triggering Krenko, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

751-2564-3459-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
751-2564-3459-4474.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

339-2011-2635.notablePrerequisites:
Jegantha and Najeela do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-2011-2635.description:
Declare Najeela and Jegantha as attackers.
Najeela and Raggadragga;s second ability triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Raggadragga trigger, untapping Jegantha.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3147-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-3678.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1689-3923-4067.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation, paying buyback, returning it to your hand and drawing 3 cards.
Discard 3 cards to untap your mana source.
After each trigger resolves, tap the source, adding a total of {2}{U}.
Repeat.
